findings.title: Continuous production approximation is used before exact hard-budget eligibility
findings.reproducibility: Recompute floor/ceil explicit daily pattern counts from persisted span, headway, cycle distance and annual-day fields; compare both exact-count bounds with each row's budget cap.
findings.consequence: Some Stage-C plans classified as budget-feasible are not guaranteed to remain under the same hard cap after route-specific exact phase selection. The same approximation can also prune boundary cases before Stage D, so search completeness is not guaranteed near the cap.
findings.recommended_fix: Before any budget-based candidate elimination on non-integral span/headway combinations, retain the full exact-count feasibility envelope or enumerate exact route-specific departure counts. Rebuild the budget-policy and Passenger Utility frontiers from that safe surface.

findings.title: Frozen integrated lineage is not yet final-decision complete
findings.reproducibility: Check the frozen target tree and the current Stage-C/S8/zero-band validation contracts.
findings.consequence: The normative constraint + robust utility + lexicographic decision rule cannot yet be executed on this integrated HEAD. Reliability/missed connections, exact budget after phasing, explicit vehicle blocks and a substantive uncertainty band are not available here.
findings.recommended_fix: Integrate independently audited exact-timetable evidence, then run the declared robustness sensitivity set and explicitly materialise decision budget plus uncertainty-band policy before authorising PRIMARY/RUNNER-UP.

findings.title: Current lower-bound baseline makes the worst-municipality safeguard non-binding
findings.reproducibility: Read the certified current-service access validation and compare candidate lower bounds against zero.
findings.consequence: Passing the safeguard cannot be interpreted as evidence that no municipality is worse than the true current service. It proves only non-regression below the proven localisable lower bound.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep the current fail-closed lower-bound rule, but propagate an explicit FINAL_DECISION_CAVEAT flag and prohibit language claiming real current-service non-regression until unresolved current stops are spatially resolved. Do not invent municipality floors.

findings.title: Audit brief and repository governance state are stale relative to frozen artifacts
findings.reproducibility: Inspect frozen HEAD files and baseline validation.
findings.consequence: A reviewer using narrative/status counts instead of content-addressed artifacts can audit or tie-break against the wrong current-service snapshot.
findings.recommended_fix: Refresh AGENT_STATUS/governance pointers and make downstream reports cite content SHA plus validation contract, not copied counts.

findings.title: Stage-C skyline is an accessibility screening frontier, not the normative robust passenger-utility ranking
findings.reproducibility: Compare PHASE2_SERVICE_DESIGN_SPEC §9/§11 with the persisted Passenger Utility axes and flags.
findings.consequence: Correlated accessibility and municipal structural upper-bound axes can preserve a broad Pareto set, but they do not implement expected/median demand-weighted GJT across the declared sensitivity set. The 260/312/365 availability assumptions also have no observed day-type demand weights yet.
findings.recommended_fix: Treat Stage C strictly as screening. Final ranking must use the declared behavioural/runtime sensitivity set at supported demand resolution, with annual-day assumptions explicitly retained as scenarios rather than empirical facts.

findings.title: Production builders contain hard-coded expected artifact cardinalities
findings.reproducibility: Static scan for equality/inequality checks against current artifact cardinalities.
findings.consequence: These checks fail closed and do not bias rankings, but they conflate lineage epoch locks with mathematical invariants and make legitimate refreshed epochs fail until code is edited.
findings.recommended_fix: Move epoch-specific cardinalities into versioned validation contracts/manifests while retaining hash and schema checks in code.

findings.title: Audited current-file lineage hashes are internally consistent
findings.consequence: No byte-level drift detected in the audited lineage edges.

findings.title: Absence of the intermediate SOME class on Stage C is a subset property
findings.reproducibility: Recompute ALL/SOME/NONE directly from public_all/public_any booleans on the 800k feeder envelope and on the Stage-C scenario×timing key subset; compare with the promoted surface.
findings.consequence: The global universe contains intermediate cases, but the Stage-C subset does not; this falsifies the hypothesis that the class was accidentally impossible in code.
findings.recommended_fix: No fix; keep explicit warning that route-level some-phase opportunity is not joint timetable feasibility.

findings.title: Station bridge preserves pedestrian-only scope and separate historical identity
findings.reproducibility: Inspect wrapper contract and access validation; core catchment summarisation uses per-unit minimum walk over a set of anchors, preventing duplicate population count.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep fail-closed bridge tests and historical 300407/EX_011 separation.

findings.title: 5/8/10 axes and two-stage skyline contract are preserved
findings.reproducibility: Inspect certified wrapper/workflow and compare stage-1 context dominance with final availability-aware Pareto theorem.
findings.consequence: No missing 8-minute axis or invalid two-stage decomposition detected.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep wrapper as the certified entry point and add direct-global skyline regression samples.

findings.title: Zero-band result is genuinely non-eliminating
findings.reproducibility: Rebuild equivalence keys at the Stage-C certified 1e-9 profile precision and run supported lexicographic fields.
findings.consequence: No candidate was silently removed by the provisional tie-break.
findings.recommended_fix: Do not reuse the pre-timetable reliability proxy as final reliability; continuity is now materialised and must enter only at the final declared tie-break stage.

findings.title: No hidden weighted score, OD downscaling, ridership inference or random search detected
findings.reproducibility: Static scan of Phase-2 production Python sources, plus contract checks in OD/S8 builders.
findings.consequence: Municipal work evidence remains structural; S8 worker counts weight rail direction only; residential population remains accessibility weight.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep explicit false flags and fail-closed source checks.

findings.title: Calendars, recovery and extension shares are explicitly assumptions rather than observed service facts
findings.reproducibility: Inspect versioned design-space config and service-policy validation.
findings.consequence: The grid is legitimate for sensitivity exploration, but calendar values cannot be described as observed current-service calendars.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve assumption labels through final reporting and test explicit day-type utility before choosing a calendar.
